rule: No candidate function is promoted from hypothesis without a predicted signature and an independent measurement.

hypotheses.label: Reconstruction / inverse-problem artifact
required_tests: algorithm null scans over unrelated terrain
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent methods recover the same shaft/chamber boundaries at the same coordinates.
predictions: Independent seismic/microgravity surveys fail to recover repeated 8-shaft boundaries at claimed coordinates.
Synthetic/null SAR processing may reproduce repeated motifs on unrelated geology.

hypotheses.label: Vertical access / excavation / transport infrastructure
predictions: Continuous ramps/shafts should produce coherent void boundaries and reachable junctions rather than isolated anomalies.
Geometry should exhibit human-scale circulation clearances and construction interfaces.

hypotheses.label: Hydraulic / fluid-management system
required_signatures: erosion/mineral deposition consistent with sustained flow
hypotheses.falsifier: No connected hydraulic path or flow residues.
predictions: A connected head path must exist between source and sink.
Surfaces should show mineral/erosion signatures consistent with sustained flow if ancient operation occurred.

hypotheses.label: Passive electromagnetic / acoustic resonator
hypotheses.falsifier: Mode structure is ordinary and insensitive to the exact geometry.
predictions: Measured/material-aware eigenmodes should be unusually sensitive to actual geometry and reproducible across solvers.
Perturbed pyramids/chambers should perform measurably worse under a preregistered objective.

hypotheses.label: Magnetic / plasma energy system
required_signatures: credible field source or remanent magnetic architecture
hypotheses.falsifier: No physically plausible magnetic-field source or energy-conversion chain.
predictions: A field-generating architecture or remanent magnetic pattern must be identifiable.
There must be a closed energy chain: ionization/input → confinement/coupling → heat/charge extraction → waste path.
Required field/pressure parameters must be compatible with materials and geometry.
